name: Breathing guide
description: A calm circle that slowly grows while breathing in, rests while holding and shrinks while breathing out, with the phase written inside.

params.name: title
params.help: Line above the circle, e.g. Breathe with me (empty: none)

params.name: hold
params.help: Seconds holding after breathing in (0: no hold)

params.name: hold_after
params.help: Seconds resting after breathing out (0: none)

params.name: cycles
params.help: Breaths to guide, then the done text (0: endless). Changing a timing or this restarts the count
